governance.note: Active levers trace to measured/structural inputs: CAMPD unit-level outage windows (outage_source=historic, exogenous availability), measured monthly delivered gas actuals with the PJM zonal gas-basis overlay, coal PRB/BIT passthrough sigmoids (the market fuel-contract passthrough mechanism; the BIT floor 0.65 is offer-curve level calibration inside the physical passthrough range 0.55-0.75, bracket-chosen between the C1 coal-volume and C3a bands as the sanctioned offer-curve tuning layer, not a price-residual adder), per-plant CAMPD must-run/committed tranches (online-Pmin), retiree CEMS availability envelope (measured availability, not generation pinning), measured EIA-930 monthly hydro with 2024 backfill, EIA-860 BTM with 2024 backfill, priced interchange at measured reference-bus prices with per-seam tie-line p90 flow/export caps, energy+reserve co-optimization on the PJM reserve requirement with measured reserve supply cap, reliability floor. No unit pinned to observed CEMS generation; no adder/haircut applied to the price residual; no input rescaled so model output lands on actuals.
